main_body: Hexagonal coffin lid drawn as a single tall tapered slab with a gold cross, seen from above. The lid fills the whole sprite, and no separate front face is drawn below it.
top_band: The whole body is the lid slab: orange-brown from row 2 to about row 30, with a gold cross. No distinct top band followed by a step and a front face.
evidence: This is a top-down plan of a coffin lid. A dark outline surrounds a tapered hexagonal slab with a cross on it. There is no lighter top band, no front-edge line, no eave shadow and no south face. Only a small darker patch at the bottom right and a thin lighter bar near row 24 hint at depth. This matches the guide's red 'top-down slab (no front)' case.

style.evidence: The wood has about 3 tones: orange-brown, a lighter side edge and a darker brown, plus a gold cross. The outline is a dark brown that leans toward the material, which is acceptable. The lid is large areas of flat colour with almost no grain, no plank lines and no speckle. Next to the stall and well references it is much thinner, with few colours per tile.
